description: Department of Archaeology - The Antiquities Ordinance Protected Monuments (related to 1963 of 12.04.2016 Gazette)
reasoning: This gazette content involves the declaration of monuments as "Protected Monuments" under the Antiquities Ordinance (Chapter 188), which constitutes a regulatory action. The Minister of Education is exercising statutory powers to create legal protections for cultural heritage sites, making this primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on establishing legal status and protection for specific monuments rather than detailing government organizational changes or individual ministerial responsibilities.
